thread:
Samir: Quick heads-up — planning the v2 API cutover tomorrow morning. Need clear owners for SDK compatibility, routing fallbacks, and the customer notice. @Alex @Maya @Priya
Alex: I can take SDK compatibility tests and the SDK PRs. Will open a PR today and add unit + smoke tests.
Maya: I'll own routing fallbacks and model-variant mapping. Will validate region rules and canary routing policy.
Priya: Dedicated infra note: we need an env var change for the new header check `X-RDW-API-VERSION=v2`. I can prep the deploy toggle.
Ethan: What's the exact migration window? Need that for the changelog and support doc.
Samir: Plan is: 24h canary, then gradual cutover over 2 weeks. Customers on old endpoints get 2 weeks notice, then 48h buffer before removing `v1`. Draft notice: https://redwood.internal/docs/drafts/v2-notice
Alex: opened PR #612 in `sdk-js`. Adds shim + opt-in flag `enableV2Compat`. Tests included. CC @Priya for env var dependency.
Priya: LGTM but will request the deploy to include the `API_VERSIONS` list. Example: `API_VERSIONS=stable,v1,v2` in `deploy/prod.env` 
Maya: For rollback plan: keep route `/{model}/v1/*` active until +48h after deprecation. Also ensure KV cache keys include the version prefix so caches don't collide.
Ethan: Will draft the public changelog blurb and a short support FAQ. Posting to #announcements after canary green.
Samir: release-bot will run the canary after Alex merges. Ping me if any infra blockers.
release-bot: deploy queued by @Alex — canary -> prod-rw-1 at 1729804488 (canary tag: v2-cutover-2024-04-01)
Alex: Ping reviewers: @Maya please review SDK PR, @Priya please review infra toggle. I won't merge until both approvals are in.
Maya: Reviewing now, a couple small comments on router tests.
Priya: Reviewing infra: need a migration job for Dedicated pools to add the new header to health checks. I'll schedule it.
Alex: Thanks — will address comments, then merge. I'll also add a short runbook snippet to /docs/v2-cutover.md with rollback steps and `kubectl` commands.
Samir: For coordination: who will post the customer notice and update the status page? @Ethan?
Ethan: Yep, I'll post the notice and a status page update immediately after canary is healthy.
Samir: Quick checklist before cutover: 1) SDK PR merged, 2) infra toggle deployed to canary, 3) routing tests green, 4) notice posted. If anything fails, we pause.
Maya: noted. I'll run the routing smoke locally and push results here.
Priya: I'll trigger the Dedicated migration job once canary is green.
Alex: Merged after approvals. CI green. Release notes: `sdk-js@1.4.0` with v2 shim.
release-bot: canary deployment successful at 1729804496 — health checks ok.
Samir: Good sign. @Ethan hold on posting to public until we confirm 1h of stable metrics, then proceed.
Ethan: will wait and post after the 1h window.
Maya: routing metrics look stable. no errors in canary traces.
Priya: Dedicated migration job completed at 1729804502.
Ethan: Posting changelog now. Short blurb + link to migration guide.
Samir: Thanks all. Scheduling a 30m async sync at 09:30 tomorrow for any fallout. If blocked, reply here and escalate to eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
Maya: 👍
Alex: 👍
Priya: 👍
Ethan: 👍
